claims.claim: On Monday the New York City Council held an AI-risk hearing and called Jacob Coxon plus officials from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and Meta; SpaceX did not appear.
claims.episode_span: on Monday the New York City Council held a hearing on the risks artificial intelligence poses to humanity
claims.source_title: Why OpenAI's Regulatory Nightmare Is Only Getting Started
claims.supporting_quote: On Monday, the New York City Council, that bastion of AI expertise, held a hearing to discuss the risks that AI poses to humanity. The council called whistleblowers like former OpenAI researcher Jacob Coxon to testify, along with officials from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and Meta Platforms (Musk’s SpaceX didn’t show, and you can’t blame them).

claims.claim: The Information also names a Senate investigation led by Josh Hawley, an FTC inquiry, an Australian government inquiry, a Florida court action, and a European inquiry.
claims.episode_span: a U.S. Senate investigation spearheaded by Senator Josh Hawley, a Federal Trade Commission inquiry, an Australian government inquiry
claims.source_title: Why OpenAI's Regulatory Nightmare Is Only Getting Started
claims.supporting_quote: OpenAI is also facing a U.S. Senate investigation spearheaded by Sen. Josh Hawley, not to mention a Federal Trade Commission inquiry and another one by the Australian government. The state of Florida has gone to court to make life miserable for OpenAI. The Europeans, of course, have gotten into the act with their own inquiry.

claims.claim: Representatives from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft and Google faced an Australian parliamentary inquiry after OpenAI revealed its technology breached Australian government agencies earlier this year.
claims.episode_span: representatives from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft and Google in front of Australia's parliamentary inquiry
claims.source_title: AI Firms Face Scrutiny in Australia
claims.supporting_quote: Australia is stepping up scrutiny of artificial intelligence, with representatives from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft and Google facing questions from a parliamentary inquiry. The hearing comes after OpenAI revealed their technology breached Australian government agencies earlier this year.

claims.claim: At the Australian hearing, OpenAI chief strategy officer Jason Kwon pledged faster safety-incident disclosures, and Anthropic representatives made similar pledges.
claims.episode_span: Jason Kwon pledged faster safety-incident disclosures. Anthropic representatives made similar pledges
claims.source_title: OpenAI and Anthropic pledge faster safety incident disclosures at Australian hearing
claims.supporting_quote: At an Australian hearing, OpenAI Chief Strategy Officer Jason Kwon pledged faster safety incident disclosures; Anthropic representatives made similar pledges (ABC)
